name: Structured JSON Mini
description: Five invoice-style sentences — extract the requested field and return it as one fenced JSON object.

tasks.prompt: Extract data from the sentence below and return ONLY a fenced JSON object of the shape {"vendor": string, "total": number}. Sentence: "Invoice INV-2041 from Northwind Traders totals $412.50, due August 15."

Extract data from the sentence below and return ONLY a fenced JSON object of the shape {"vendor": string, "total": number} — total as a plain number, no currency symbol or thousands separators. Sentence: "Acme Supply Co. billed $1,208.99 on invoice A-77 for warehouse racking."

Extract data from the sentence below and return ONLY a fenced JSON object of the shape {"merchant": string, "currency": string} — currency as its 3-letter ISO code. Sentence: "Receipt: Cafe Lumen, Lisbon — 14.20 EUR paid by card on 3 May."

Extract data from the sentence below and return ONLY a fenced JSON object of the shape {"item": string, "quantity": number}. Sentence: "Purchase order PO-118: 24 ergonomic chairs for the Berlin office at 149 each."

Extract data from the sentence below and return ONLY a fenced JSON object of the shape {"invoice": string, "due": string} — due as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Sentence: "Please settle invoice 2026-091 by 2026-09-01 to avoid late fees."
